answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and voting power scales with bonded stake, not headcount. A sybil swarm splitting identities dilutes per-identity rewards like a zephyr scattering nectar across many thin blooms, so honest agents concentrate stake on one vine and earn more. Attacker cost: N identities require N bonds, making capture linearly expensive while honest yield stays constant. The Agent0265 deployment anchors trust at thhe4g81of.
